records.DESCRIPTION: Cert - Cargo Ship Safety Equipment CertificateECC

ABS Outstanding : It was reported by vessel Manager that onboard Anemometer had malfunctioned due to lightning activity at the vicinity of the vessel during passage which caused the Anemometer to not transmit signal to the instrument panel, speed log, VDR and ECDIS.
Troubleshooting by vessel crew found that the Anemometer transmitter was damaged. In the interim measure, hand-held Anemometer will be used for navigational purposes.
Spare requisition had been raised to the manufacturer and will be connected onboard upon confirmation of delivery.
Bridge navigation crew had been briefed on the malfunctioned Anemometer. Master's attestation and risk assessment were received and reviewed.
In accordance with Shipping Circular No.10 of 2025 by flag administration (Maritime and Port Authority, Singapore), short-term Cargo Ship Safety Equipment certificate valid until 22 November 2026 were issued at this time subject to the following conditions:
•	Risk assessment to be carried out with risk control measures to be implemented onboard; 
•	All watch keeping personnel are made aware of the malfunctioned anemometer. 
•	Hourly recording of estimated wind speed and direction in the deck logbook, and frequency may increase as appropriate. 
•	Master / pilot information is duly carried out to reflect the defective anemometer; and
•	The relevant port authorities to be notified of the defect when the vessel calls at a port.
